messages:
Ana: Quick heads up — we just hit 30 consecutive days with zero customer-facing incidents. :tada: :seedling:
Marcus: omg, that's wild. massive props to infra/oncall/observability teams. coffee cart + small gong? :coffee: :metal:
Sophie: I can bring bagels tomorrow morning and a box of tiny succulents for the kitchen table. :baguette_bread: :green_heart:
Jordan: deploy-bot: `30d_success_rate=0.99995` — absolutely stellar.
deploy-bot: SLOs: 30d success_rate=0.99995, p99_latency=120ms, p999_latency=350ms. No P1 incidents recorded.
Lina: Huge shoutout to the tracing changes and the cache tweaks — those real-time dashboards saved so many wakeups. :raised_hands:
Ana: low-key celebration plan: silent gong at 4pm in the kitchen (tiny desk gong), bagels + succulents for folks in office. RSVP with emoji so we know how many plants to buy. :seedling: :calendar:
Marcus: :raised_hands: in! will bring a tiny brass gong i stole from a conference swag table years ago.
Sophie: :seedling: :baguette_bread: Count me in, i'll bring cream cheese options.
Jordan: :metal: for the gong. can we also do a 1-minute 'share one quick win' circle? quiet & wholesome.
ops-bot: Incident tracker note — last incident: 2026-02-06 03:12 UTC, mean time to acknowledge 2m, mean time to resolve 11m. P1s in past 30d: 0.
Ana: absolutely. tiny celebration, huge gratitude. please keep an eye on customer signals but let's savor this. proud of you all. :heart:
Marcus: can we get a photo of the succulents on the plant shelf for the #hallway-plants channel? :)
Sophie: yes, i'll do a 'before' and 'after' snap. also thinking of a little note card: "30 days, zero P1s — thanks team"
Jordan: lol add a sticker of a tiny astronaut 
Ana: perfect. See you at 4pm (silent gong).
Marcus: :wave:
